ops.title: Bind sustained ship/rebase IO to exact repeated reads before optimizing
ops.description: Owner /root; implementation lane queued independently of CCX563/v0.87.38. Evidence: FE/urgent-latest-current/action-point-candidates-private.json and protected-git-parent-identities-private.json, sampled ccx0.87.36 ship PIDs33019/20069/32100 and stack rebase47080. Parent reports sustained native read counters around3.3-3.6MiB/s each; file binding remains UNKNOWN. All three ship argv include --no-watch. Source98e42f59 internal/cli/ship.go:688-695 returns before CI watching for noWatch; watchCIRun:2680-2696 delegates gh polling rather than ref scanning. Direct show-ref calls in trunk.go:58, trunkstate.go:114 and shipgt.go:2992 are targeted --verify --quiet, unlike sampled bare show-ref with filter.lfs arguments. Next: fresh protected process ancestry plus bounded open-file/native read evidence on unchanged operation; identify direct caller and exact repeated ref/index payload. Do not signal valid operations. Preserve PR claims, ledger and wire semantics; keep candidate out of38 carrier. CI must grade real command/read counters on unchanged iterations, and any authorized fix must reach release/install/affected-case verification.

ops.text: Fresh process/file evidence identifies repeated caller and payload, or exonerates the watch hypothesis explicitly
